file_retirement.description: Unreferenced bucket keys, retained in trash until a person chooses to purge them.

at.description: When these keys were first observed unreferenced; absent while an erased owner still stands.

owner.description: The app, space or visit whose explicit erasure retires these keys.

delete_retired_files.description: Finish previously queued file retirements while retaining every recorded key in trash.

release_remake.description: a release to make again as itself, compiled by the toolkit serving it now (toolkit.ts), done once by the remake sweep its row wakes

source.description: the release it serves that its toolkit has moved on from

fence.description: the release fence the last run drew, kept before it took it; the next run lifts it if that run died holding it

began.description: when the run under way began; null once it ends

since.description: when the first of the runs in a row that died unfinished, or that Cloudflare could not answer, began; null once one finishes

reported.description: when the runs since `since` that Cloudflare could not answer were reported as an outage, once; null once one finishes

through.description: how far the last run that finished read; the next reads on from there
